contamination_audit.mechanism: demonstration_base(base, 3) restores the validation query shape orientation and layout while using the same marker turn, so the demonstration reproduces the query input and oracle-correct target
contamination_audit.structural_holdout_failure: The query-conditioned demonstrations are derived from validation base factors and include the reserved validation orientation-relation cell; nominal TRAIN labeling does not make them independent TRAIN support.

v2_disposition.permitted_use: Generator-forensic and contamination evidence only. Any later-recovered predictions must be labeled contaminated descriptive evidence and may not support model-capability, marker-grounding or structural-generalization claims.

preserve: the four matched marker-turn counterfactuals per base
minimum conditional support of 8 canonical bases per reserved cell

fixed_demonstration_bank.selection_rule: Before constructing any validation prompt, select the lexicographically smallest canonical_base_id from each of four fixed TRAIN-only structural cells: (orientation 0, EAST), (orientation 1, SOUTH), (orientation 2, WEST), and (orientation 3, NORTH). Assign them prospectively to demonstration turns 0, 1, 2 and 3 respectively.
fixed_demonstration_bank.reuse_rule: For a given condition, use the exact same four ordered demonstration input-output pairs for every validation query. Demonstration inputs are identical across conditions; only their condition-defined outputs differ.

output_color_isolation.method: Add one dedicated output-color swatch at input cell (8,8) in every fixed demonstration and validation query.
output_color_isolation.requirements: The swatch must be spatially disjoint from object, reference marker and turn marker; its color must equal the sole non-background target color for that task. Preserve validation output-color diversity.

smallest_valid_amendment.condition_observability: Condition identity remains encoded only by the fixed native ARC demonstration outputs. Do not expose condition names, latent metadata, hashes or explanatory text to the model.
smallest_valid_amendment.target_boundary: Freeze and hash input-only validation prompts before model loading. Keep targets in a separate scorer sidecar and freeze all raw generations before joining the sidecar.

mandatory_cpu_gates: Exactly one frozen demonstration-bank identity per condition; every validation prompt for that condition must contain byte-identical ordered demonstrations.
Zero validation query-input collisions with any demonstration input.
Zero validation query-input plus target pairs duplicated by any demonstration pair.
Every demonstration base belongs to a TRAIN-only non-reserved structural cell; no reserved validation orientation-relation cell occurs in demonstrations.
The demonstration selector accepts no validation row, validation latent factor or validation target as input.
Every task has an observable non-overlapping output-color swatch and the scorer target uses exactly that swatch color.
Every canonical validation base retains all sixteen condition-by-turn views, and marker counterfactual query inputs differ only at the declared turn-marker cells.
Input-only prompts contain no targets, latent factors, split labels, condition names or hashes.
Deterministic byte-identical regeneration and all frozen file SHA256 checks pass.
CPU unit and integration tests include negative fixtures reproducing the V2 turn-3 duplicate and reserved-cell exposure failures.

conditional_one_shot_execution_authoriza.condition: Effective only after every mandatory CPU gate passes and the exact implementation/data commit is non-force-pushed, locally clean, synchronized to RunPod and bound in a fresh launch manifest.
conditional_one_shot_execution_authoriza.fallback_rule: On pre-output OOM or demonstrated capacity failure, clear the failed attempt and restart the complete primary generation at the next rung; never mix rungs in an accepted result.
conditional_one_shot_execution_authoriza.batch1_sensitivity_subset: Use one fixed canonical validation base per reserved structural cell, selected by lowest canonical_base_id; include all four turns and all four conditions, totaling 64 prompts.
conditional_one_shot_execution_authoriza.required_batch_agreement: Identical parser-validity status, parsed grid and exact-grid outcome on all 64 sensitivity prompts; any disagreement yields NUMERICAL_OR_BATCH_SENSITIVITY_INCONCLUSIVE.
conditional_one_shot_execution_authoriza.on_gate_failure: Do not load a model or launch GPU work; set REVIEW_REQUIRED with the single failed scientific gate.
conditional_one_shot_execution_authoriza.on_launch_or_runtime_failure: Preserve evidence and do not launch a second detached job without a replacement-run authorization.
